canDo: Can use le/la/les/lui/leur to avoid repetition while keeping references clear.
review: Review the parts of a sentence; tell the direct object apart from à + a person.
input: Listening: phone/service exchanges; reading: an email thread.
output: Write a 110-word message with at least 5 pronoun replacements; a spoken role-play.
checkpoint: ≥8 out of 10 replacements correct; don’t use lui/leur as a COD.
challenge: Today’s challenge: write a 5–6-sentence message in French to a friend or relative saying that you lent them a book, called them and so on, replacing repeated nouns with le / la / les / lui / leur at least 5 times; then check that each pronoun comes before the verb.

questions.why: What’s missing is la notice and le certificat de garantie. The installation was done (« me l'ont installé »).
« garanti deux ans à partir de la date de livraison ; le certificat n'est donc pas indispensable ». It runs from the delivery date, not the order date.
Two solutions: by post + download from the website. Asking the delivery men to come back is what the customer had already tried.
« Écrase-le et mélange-le à la nourriture, sinon il le recrache ». The prescription is just a document left next to it.
« Ne le laisse pas y aller : la rambarde est trop basse » — y refers to le balcon.
The only condition given for going to the vet is two days without eating.
« Il ne s'agit pas de le former techniquement » — technical training is the project leaders’ job.
You volunteer by writing to Sandrine before Friday; Monday is when she replies.
prix coûtant = cost price. prix libre applies to second-hand parts; 15 € is the annual fee.
« Nous vous le disons franchement et nous vous orientons », and they give the contact details of three professional repairers.
« votre commande a été séparée en deux colis ». Stock and lost parcels aren’t mentioned.
« Je vous le renvoie tout de suite par courriel ». The complaint can only be opened after Friday.
« ne le faites pas avant vendredi » — the carrier needs a day’s margin.
The out-of-stock medicine can be ordered but won’t arrive until the next afternoon; since it’s needed that evening, a générique équivalent is given.
« pendant le repas … ne les prenez pas à jeun » — two tablets a day, with meals.
The only signal given to stop and see a doctor is vertiges.
He asks her to run Thursday’s workshop in Thomas’s place. Revising the materials isn’t part of it; only the answers to the second part need sending.
« les exercices de la deuxième partie ne sont pas corrigés » — only this part’s answers need preparing.
« dis-le-moi avant demain midi, je demanderai à Sofiane » — contacting Sofiane is Pascal’s job.
« Le justificatif de domicile, lui, nous l'avons bien reçu » — it’s the proof of address that has arrived.
« sinon on ne le retrouve pas ». The 10th is the submission deadline; the 15th is when the committee meets.
« Si nous recevons le document avant le 10 » is the only condition.

V11-01.zh: to go to someone (for help/a service)
V11-01.exZh: The delivery men told me to come to you.

V11-02.exZh: Let me explain the problem: I ordered four items and received two.

V11-03.exZh: The product I received doesn’t match the model I chose.

V11-04.exZh: If the repair is too complicated, we’ll tell you frankly.

V11-05.exZh: You don’t need the certificate to claim under the guarantee.

V11-06.exZh: Your appliance has a two-year guarantee from the delivery date.

V11-07.exZh: If you don’t receive the parcel on Thursday, we’ll open a complaint.

V11-08.exZh: I’d like to have a mistake on my order corrected.

V11-09.zh: to give someone a day’s margin
V11-09.exZh: The carrier asks us to give it a day’s margin.

V11-10.zh: to look after, to take care of …
V11-10.exZh: Thank you so much for looking after him this week!

V11-11.exZh: Don’t give him more than half a tin: he tends to put on weight.

V11-12.exZh: It’s not a question of training him technically: the project leaders take care of that.

V11-13.exZh: New starters don’t have access to client files before their training.

V11-14.exZh: Four people will join the team in April.

V11-15.exZh: If a new starter asks you for this file, refer them to their mentor.

V11-16.exZh: We can’t keep them waiting more than an hour.

V11-17.zh: instead of someone, in someone’s place
V11-17.exZh: Do you repair the bike for me?

V11-18.exZh: If the repair is too complicated, we direct you to a repairer in the neighbourhood.

V11-19.exZh: Hello, I’ve come to collect my father’s medicines.

V11-20.exZh: The third medicine I don’t have in stock, but I can order it.

V11-21.exZh: Above all, don’t take these tablets on an empty stomach.

V11-22.exZh: Thomas sent me his slides and I’m forwarding them to you right away.

V11-23.exZh: If you can’t, tell me before noon tomorrow.

V11-24.exZh: Thomas is away on Thursday: could you stand in for him?

V11-25.exZh: Have you submitted an application online?

V11-26.exZh: The pharmacist knows this problem well: I asked her for advice.

V11-27.exZh: He’s a good repairer — I trust him.

V11-28.zh: to give someone one’s contact details
V11-28.exZh: We know three repairers in the neighbourhood and we’ll give you their contact details.

V11-29.exZh: Your file is incomplete: we still need your tax notice.

V11-30.zh: in the subject line of the email
V11-30.exZh: Put the file number in the subject line of the email, otherwise we can’t find it.

V11-31.exZh: Thomas is on sick leave until the end of the week.

V11-32.exZh: He was supposed to run Thursday morning’s workshop with the trainees.

V11-33.exZh: By mistake, you weren’t given the instructions.

V11-34.exZh: We sent the second parcel yesterday.

V11-35.exZh: Could you send me the instructions by post?

V11-36.zh: Thank you in advance for … (closing a letter)
V11-36.exZh: Thank you in advance for your reply.

V11-37.exZh: I’d like to exchange this item for the model I ordered.

V11-38.exZh: I’d like to make an appointment for next week.

V11-39.exZh: My neighbour did me a favour: she looked after my cat for a week.

V11-40.exZh: My neighbour gave me a hand with the move.

V11-41.zh: to get on well with someone
V11-41.exZh: I get on well with my colleagues; I see them at weekends too.

V11-42.zh: to ask after someone, to check in on someone
V11-42.exZh: I call my grandmother every Sunday to see how she’s doing.

V11-43.exZh: I got their message and replied to them straight away.

V11-44.exZh: I called customer service three times without getting an answer.

V11-45.zh: to stay in touch with someone
V11-45.exZh: After he left, I stayed in touch with my former colleague.
